## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff format .`, `ruff check .`, `mypy` and `pytest` pass
- [ ] Output pixels are unchanged, or the change is meant to alter them and `tests/golden/expected.json` and `docs/presets` were regenerated (see `.claude/CLAUDE.md`)
- [ ] New behaviour has tests
- [ ] The `OKF.md` of every directory with an added, removed or changed file is updated
- [ ] Any texture added may be redistributed, with its author and license credited
